name: distributed-ai-platform-frontend
description: UX-01, UX-19, UX-28: Offline-first frontend test, syntax-check, typecheck & Playwright E2E toolchain (zero CDN).

scripts.check-syntax: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async fs => { for (const f of fs.readdirSync('../master/static/js').filter(x => x.endsWith('.js'))) { await import('node:child_process').then(cp => cp.execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', '../master/static/js/' + f])); } console.log('All JS modules syntax-checked OK'); })"
